title: AI × Math 每日精选
subtitle: 自动推理、形式化证明、数学智能与基础模型。
method: OpenReview 公开元数据采集、历史去重、规则筛选与模型审阅

items.title: MultiCILP: Modular Autoregressive Neurosymbolic Logic Programming with Provably Sound Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: In the area of neurosymbolic AI, neural networks have been routinely coupled with symbolic components for downstream reasoning, yet their capacity for sound reasoning and systematic generalization remain poorly understood. Reasoning shortcuts - spurious concept assignments by the symbolic component - have become a fundamental obstacle of this coupled neurosymbolic architecture, with existing approaches offering no formal guarantees against shortcuts. This paper introduces MultiCILP, a modular neurosymbolic architecture integrating state-of-the-art networks used for pattern recognition with a standard autoregressive network that is provably equivalent to logic programming for the purpose of sound reasoning. The autoregressive network extends the Connectionist Inductive Logic Programming (CILP) neurosymbolic system to work with multimodal models and ReLU activation functions. A theorem shows that the extended MultiCILP system is sound, carrying out formal logical reasoning in a standard neural network. We investigate reasoning in MultiCILP combined with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Transformer encoders using the standard MNIST addition benchmark for the investigation of reasoning shortcuts in neurosymbolic AI. MultiCILP is shown to be capable of exact digit addition for operands of arbitrary length by executing the underlying logic program, thus extrapolating systematically beyond the training set to a much larger number of digits in the operands. Experimentally, MultiCILP achieves faster training, a high knowledge-completion accuracy with as little as 15\% background knowledge, substantially outperforming a standard neural network of comparable size. MultiCILP maintains 100\% accuracy under operand-length extrapolation, while Transformers and standard multi-layer Perceptrons collapse to 0\% accuracy out-of-distribution. More broadly, this paper indicates that encoding logic directly into the neural network, rather than appending a symbolic component or a harness, is a promising and scalable path toward correct neural network reasoning and efficient learning with systematic generalization.
items.summary_zh: 提出 MultiCILP：一种模块化自回归神经符号逻辑编程架构，将模式识别网络与可证明等价于逻辑编程的自回归网络结合，用于可靠的形式逻辑推理。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作给出了神经网络执行逻辑程序时可靠性的定理，并在任意长度数字加法外推上报告了可检验结果；这为评估神经符号系统能否避免推理捷径、实现系统性泛化提供了清晰任务。
items.abstract_zh: 在神经符号人工智能领域，神经网络通常与符号组件耦合以完成下游推理，但它们进行可靠推理和系统性泛化的能力仍缺乏充分理解。推理捷径，即符号组件作出的虚假概念赋值，已成为这种耦合式神经符号架构的根本障碍；现有方法无法对避免此类捷径给出形式保证。本文提出 MultiCILP，一种模块化神经符号架构：它将用于模式识别的先进网络与一个标准自回归网络结合，后者在可靠推理意义上可证明地等价于逻辑编程。该自回归网络扩展了连接主义归纳逻辑编程（CILP）神经符号系统，使其能够适用于多模态模型和 ReLU 激活函数。文中一个定理表明，扩展后的 MultiCILP 系统是可靠的，能够在标准神经网络中执行形式逻辑推理。作者研究了 MultiCILP 与卷积神经网络及 Transformer 编码器结合时的推理表现，采用标准 MNIST 加法基准测试考察神经符号人工智能中的推理捷径。结果显示，MultiCILP 可通过执行底层逻辑程序，对任意长度操作数进行精确数字加法，因此能系统地外推到训练集之外、操作数位数大得多的情形。实验上，MultiCILP 训练更快；即使仅有 15%的背景知识，也能获得很高的知识补全准确率，显著优于规模相当的标准神经网络。在操作数长度外推中，MultiCILP 保持 100% 准确率，而 Transformer 和标准多层感知机在分布外情形中降至 0%。更广泛地说，本文表明，将逻辑直接编码进神经网络，有望成为获得正确神经网络推理、高效学习和系统性泛化的一条可扩展路径。
